This catalogue accompanies @sec-ch05. It lists every ctest entry that carries a claim of that chapter at the pin
`snapy@e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0`, with what it asserts, its tolerance and the outcome of one run, and
the claims of the chapter's executable check.

### The run

All entries below were run once [sha `e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0`; run: `ctest -V` on a Release build of
the pin with CUDA off, 2026-10-10, CPU, double; 1 rank, the `_mp` entries 2 ranks under `torchrun`]. The 26 C++ and
CMake entries passed. The two Python entries failed under ctest, because the interpreter imported an older installed
snapy instead of the pin's build (`unknown key 'forcing/const-gravity/gravity-work'`); run directly against the pin's
build (`python tests/test_wb_ref4_order.py`, `python tests/test_x1_centroid_rest.py`) both pass. Every `_cuda` case was
skipped by the build. **Pending: a CUDA run at the pin, and a ctest run of the two Python entries with the import path
set to the pin's build.**

### ctest entries

| test (ctest name) | what it asserts | tolerance | outcome |
|----------------|-------------|-----|-----|
| `test_hydro_ref_x1.release` | CPU path equals the tensor path; with the wall clamp ghosts do not reach the interior, without it they do; thin blocks; wall reference independent of the block size | $2\times10^{-12}$ double; exact; $10^{-14}$ | pass (6), CUDA case skipped |
| `test_hydro_options.release` | `wb-wall-clamp` ships enabled and changes the reference | differ $>10^{-13}$ | pass (11), CUDA case skipped |
| `test_wb_ref_wall.release` | $\rho_{\mathrm{sf}}$, $\rho_L$, $\rho_R$ at faces 1-2 next to both walls second order, $n_1$ 32 $\to$ 64; wall faces within $1.5\times$ the interior | order $\ge1.7$ | pass; orders 1.81-2.12 |
| `test_wb_ref4_order_python` | switch on: order $\ge2.75$ at 1 and 3 e-folds; off: $<2.5$ | `ORDER_ON 2.75`, `ORDER_OFF 2.5` | pass when run against the pin; orders on 3.88-4.07, off 2.04-2.21 |
| `test_x1_centroid_rest_python` | switch on: rest force $<10^{-10}$; off: $>10^{-8}$ at $r_0/H=5$ | `TOL_ON 1e-10`, `TOL_OFF 1e-8` | pass when run against the pin; on $\le3.3\times10^{-14}$, off $2.4\times10^{-5}$ |
| `test_pref_local_seam.release` | $p_{\mathrm{ref}}$ continuous at an in-process seam; four blocks equal one after 200 steps | $10^{-6}$; $10^{-12}$ | pass (2) |
| `test_x1_seam_split.release` | the switches-off arm sets up with $n_g=1$ | runs | pass |
| `test_x1_seam_split_x1_centroid.release` | split equals one block, $n_h$ 1 and 0 | $10^{-13}$ | pass; gap 0 |
| `test_x1_seam_split_wb_ref4.release` | split with the resolution flag at the seam equals one block | $10^{-13}$ | pass; gaps $6.8\times10^{-15}$, $1.7\times10^{-15}$ |
| `test_x1_seam_split_wb_ref4_gravity_0.release` | gravity off, $n_g=1$ steps under the switch | runs | pass |
| `test_x1_seam_split_mp.release`, `_x1_centroid`, `_wb_ref4` (2 ranks) | two ranks equal two blocks and one block | $10^{-13}$ | pass; gaps 0 to $6.8\times10^{-15}$ |
| `test_face_floor.release`, `_wb_ref4`, `_x1_centroid` | adjacent-density floor; switched fluxes; unresolved column flux $2.83191\times10^{-8}$ | $10^{-3}$ abs; $10^{-3}$, $10^{-5}$ relative | pass (2 each); flux $2.8319\times10^{-8}$ in all arms |
| `test_balance_column.release`, `_wb_ref4`, `_x1_centroid` | transfer to a block bitwise; marched and moist columns come out at rest; fixed point; refusals; switch predicates | bitwise; $10^{-10}$; $10^{-14}$ | pass (11 each), CUDA cases skipped |
| `test_hydrostatic.release` | cubed-sphere atmosphere at rest, `non-hydrostatic: 0.` | $10^{-8}$ | pass; $7.84\times10^{-15}$ |

and the `_cuda` gtest cases inside the CPU binaries) were not run.

### The chapter's executable check

`python3 src/snapy_report/ch05/wbref_check.py` runs on CPU without importing snapy; its committed output is
`src/snapy_report/ch05/wbref_check.out`, and `src/tests/test_ch05.py` runs it with the chapter's figure tests. One run
[numpy 2.2.4, sympy 1.14.0, double] passes all 21 claims.

| output label | assertion | tolerance | what it does not establish |
|----------------|-------------|-----|-----|
| `[C1]`, `[C2]` | six-face interior and wall-row weights | exact rationals | the guards around them |
| `[C3]`, `[C7]`, `[C8]` | filter moments, cubic wall values, quartic-primitive face weights | exact rationals | the code's stencil assembly |
| `[C4]`–`[C6]` | repeated wall cell first order; continuation second order; continuation bounds | exact; sampled | non-uniform grids |
| `[C9]`, `[C10]`, `[C20]` | log-mean, top anchor, uniform test | $10^{-14}$; closed form | stretched-grid dynamics |
| `[C11]` | independent rebuild reproduces `test_wb_ref_wall`'s 40 printed numbers | $6\times10^{-4}$ relative (printed digits) | the solver's $\rho_L$, $\rho_R$ |
| `[C12]`–`[C14]` | wall orders; six-face order 5.87; face-density offset formula, base order 2.00 and `SNAP_WB_REF4` order 4.68 | fitted orders | solver dynamics |
| `[C15]` | `balance_column`'s iteration converges on a perturbed column | residual $<10^{-10}$ | a convergence proof |
| `[C16]`–`[C18]` | plain-mean conversion exactness; pressure-source identities; centroid offset | $10^{-12}$; exact | compiled ghost behaviour |
| `[C19]` | hydrostatic-mode correction cancels at rest | $10^{-12}$ | behaviour away from rest |
| `[C21]` | Favre ratio of $r^2$ means against the plain mean | exact | the size of the $1/R$ remainder |
